messages:
neha: FYI — incoming request from LargeFin for confirmed pricing on hosted vs reserved + overage caps. They want a quote for ~500M tokens/mo, strict data isolation, and ability to roll unused credits. Need product input on feasible packaging and priority.
jamie: Ticket #4321 from support. Customer asked for per-token for generation + embeddings, reserved pool for 4x A100-type instances, we pushed docs link. They asked about credits rollover and caps on monthly overages.
eli: Sales: they said competitor X offers $0.003/token with 20% discount on commit. We should propose a two-tier: reserved commit discount + capped overage rate. We can do committed + soft cap + hard cap.
samir: Pricing: need model mix (gpt-like vs embeddings), tokens split gen:embed approx 80:20? Also need sequence length. Quick calc:
```
Base-hosted: $0.004/token gen, $0.0015/token embed
Reserved estimate (500M): ~ $X (see calc)
```
samir: I'll run exact unit econ but short answer: we can offer ~30-40% commit discount if they take reserved capacity and a staged overage price 2x hosted rate with a monthly hard cap.
alina: Finance: target gross margin >= 55% across the deal. If we give >35% avg discount we need exec approval. Billing must be monthly in arrears; credits rollover limited to 3 months.
maria: Eng: Dedicated pool for 4 GPUs + private control plane is fine but note warmup cache and KV sizes will impact perf. We should confirm their per-request latency SLO.
neha: Product: priority check — is this an enterprise ACV > $200k ARR? Sales to confirm. If yes we should accelerate and make an intake card + PRD; else standard backlog.
eli: They indicated $300k ARR potential. Also asked for a trial with 2-week reserved burst.
neha: OK high priority then. Need: (1) written proposal for pricing bands (hosted/reserved/overage), (2) list of operational concessions (rollover, caps), (3) launch criteria + what needs eng work.
jamie: I'll make the intake card in /board and add the support transcript + their usage histogram. Can @samir drop a quick unit-econ snapshot to attach?
samir: Yep — pushing a quick calc now. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
pricing-bot: Automated calc: Reserved per-token blended = $0.0029 | Hosted avg = $0.0041 | Overage capped @ $0.006. See /internal/pricing/quotes/1763456789
alina: If pricing-bot numbers hold, finance ok to greenlight with exec review for discount authority.
neha: Great. Action items: Jamie create intake card by EOD, Samir attach econ and range, Maria add engineering impact estimate. I'll set a call with customer Thurs 3pm PT.
eli: noted. I'll prep negotiation points. :thumbsup: 
jamie: Created intake card: https://board.internal/req/1763456789 — added participants and draft approach.
neha: Thanks team — marking thread resolved for product triage. react :white_check_mark:
